title.hr: Testovi obnove kao dokaz: cijelo okruženje u godini dana
title.en: Restore tests as evidence: covering the estate in a year

concept.hr: Kopiju dokazuje test obnove; redoslijed testova odlučuje što ostaje netestirano
concept.en: A restore test proves a backup; the order of tests decides what is never tested

summary.hr: Rasporedi godinu testova obnove za dvanaest sustava u malo termina; čitaj pokrivenost, netestirane sustave, trajanje uz RTO i zapise za revizora.
summary.en: Schedule a year of restore tests for twelve systems in a few slots; read the coverage, the untested systems, times against the RTO and the auditor's records.

concept.hr: Sve je zeleno cijelu godinu, a nijedna obnova nije dokazana
concept.en: Green all year, and not one restore is proven
